decision.reasoning_trace: I prioritized established audio brands with high ratings and substantial review counts. I considered both new and renewed options to find the best value. The Bose SoundLink Color II (137) is excellent but expensive at $124.95. The JBL Flip 5 Renewed (001) is a good value at $79.90, but the JBL Charge 4 Renewed (013) at $89.95 offers a significant upgrade in sound depth and battery performance for a small price difference. The Philips (084) was considered for its 360-degree sound at a budget price, but the durability and bass reputation of the JBL Charge series made it the most compelling choice for a portable outdoor-ready speaker.
